caption:
Google deleted a feature every local business used.

The Q&A section on Google Business Profile is being phased out after Google shut down its API in November 2025. In its place: Ask Maps, a Gemini-powered feature that answers customer questions in real time, pulling from your reviews, photos, and website content instead of anything you typed yourself.

Here's what that means for your shop. You can no longer seed your own Q&A with helpful answers. The AI reads your reviews and uses them to answer the exact question a prospect has before they ever call you.

This week, ask every closed job for a review that names the specific service, not just a star rating. That's the raw material the AI cites to the next person asking.

The Black Arrow platform keeps that review request going automatically after every job closes.
